newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Reliance raises $300 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: India's Reliance raises $300 mln loan.

text.p: India's Reliance Petroleum Ltd said it concluded a $300 million loan on Thursday.
The loan is at an interest rate of 2.0 to 2.5 percent over LIBOR, the company said.
"This is a syndicated project finance loan facility with final maturity of 10 years," it said in a statement.
The loan was arranged by ABN-AMRO Bank, Bank of America, Bankers Trust and Toronto Dominion, Reliance said.
It said more than 25 banks from Europe, Japan, North America and Asia participated in the deal.
"Final allocations are expected to be scaled back substantially because of the large oversubscription," it said.
The loan is not backed by any government, bank or financial institution gurantee, the company said.
Reliance Petroleum is building a $2.4 billion refinery with a capacity to process 15 million tonnes of crude oil a year at Jamnagar on India's western coast.
